global_portfolio_semantics.secondary: FAE — Mainnet Readiness & Canonical State Reconciliation

source_of_truth_rule: Consumers read the current canonical ledger and referenced evidence; they must not reconstruct state from chat history.

state_semantics.DONE: Evidence-backed gate is complete at its declared authority class.
state_semantics.ACTIVE: Workstream or live state currently active; does not imply mainnet authority.
state_semantics.SECONDARY: Runnable secondary workstream that must yield on shared-state conflict with ACTIVE.
state_semantics.CONDITION_WAIT: Machine may resume automatically when the stated condition becomes true.
state_semantics.SCHEDULED: Machine may resume at/after the stated checkpoint after revalidation.
state_semantics.HUMAN_GATE: Next admissible advancement requires Waterfound physical/account/authority action.
state_semantics.EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE: Required evidence is not currently admitted; no PASS may be inferred.
state_semantics.RESEARCH_ONLY: Evidence may inform research but cannot change active protocol authority.
state_semantics.BLOCKED: No current admissible advancement until dependencies change.
state_semantics.CLOSED: Bounded project is closed; only its declared recurring/reopen condition remains.

durable_mapping.rule: can_auto_advance and wake_condition further restrict execution; they never widen authority.

steward_display_rule.unresolved_mainnet_critical: Show when decision-relevant; do not manufacture urgency before prerequisites are satisfied.

authority_rules: Ledger state changes do not create protocol or mainnet authority.
HUMAN_GATE may be cleared only by evidence of the exact Waterfound action required.
Research-only evidence cannot be promoted by mapping it to DONE.
LAB_VERIFIED, INTEGRATED_MAIN, COMBINED_MAIN_VERIFIED and LIVE remain distinct.
Frozen historical failure evidence is append-only.
Before integrating a shared canonical surface, re-resolve current main and serialize against concurrent work.
fail_closed_conditions: consensus/economic/mainnet authority changes not backed by an explicit separate authority artifact
evidence ref disappears or changes incompatibly
current main differs after a shared-state reconciliation candidate was prepared
